title: [Aladin]: Building a Freelancer Community for Cardano

ms.promise:

ms.report:
[READ CAREFUL, please!]
Dear Cardano Community and Milestone Reviewers,
We are thrilled to share our foundational assets, content production results, and our strategic go-to-market plan.
Before presenting the deliverables, we want to provide brief context on our Long-Term Vision vs. Current Strategic Focus, which shaped the content we produced in this milestone.
1. The Vision:
Aladin Work aims to be a global platform connecting everyday needs with local talent. In our ecosystem, anyone—from an anxious parent needing a tutor to an elderly person in the US needing home repairs—can be an "Aladin" (Hirer) by simply making a "Wish" on our app. They are instantly matched with the best local "Genies" (Freelancers).
To make this seamless for non-crypto users, the entire backend is powered invisibly by Cardano: utilizing JemNFTs for immutable reputation, Midnight for contract privacy, and the PhoenixKey DID for seedless onboarding.
👉 For full technical details, please refer to our published Aladin Work Whitepaper v4.0.
2. The Current Focus: 
The "Vietnam Beachhead Strategy"
While we successfully tested content for the broad "Hirer" audience (garnering hundreds of thousands of views globally), attempting to onboard all industries worldwide simultaneously is unfeasible. Therefore, for the execution of this specific Catalyst grant, we are implementing a focused "Vietnam Beachhead Strategy."
We are concentrating 100% of our community-building resources on high-value digital professionals (Developers, UI/UX Designers, SEOers, Creators) in Vietnam.
The evidence below reflects the successful foundation of this highly targeted, Web3-focused freelancer community.
A. Output: Foundational Strategy & Channels
